notes.title: Tropity Devlogs
notes.content:
Coming soon. Tropity will start uploading devlogs to keep our community up to date with what we are creating and how fast we are progressing.

[h2]Where will they be posted?[/h2]

Good question!

We have started up a new YouTube channel where we will post the devlogs and host development live streams and Q&A's. So come along and join us in creating one of the biggest virtual worlds ever. (We will also be giving our active viewers early access and other Tropity perks for when we are ready to launch)

[h2]Links[/h2]

New YouTube Channel: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@tropityofficial]@tropityofficial[/url]

Tropity Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/TropityOfficial]@TropityOfficial[/url]
Tropity Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/tropity.official/]@tropity.official[/url]


We look forward to seeing you at our devlogs and events!
